title: preferences_down
description: Phone → watch. The phone's settings the wrist honours. Not session-scoped: it describes the user, not a workout. The wrist keeps the copy with the latest generatedAt — a tie goes to the later-received copy — so an older copy that arrives late never replaces a newer one.

effortRatingPrompt.description: Whether a session the wrist ends asks for the session effort rating. The phone's effort-rating setting, as it stood when generatedAt was written.

restPingSeconds.description: 0 = Off; the wrist's rest-ping interval in seconds, from the phone's Rest Ping setting.
